name: Anchorage Square Mall
summary: Anchorage Square is a 24-hour lifestyle plaza at San Francisco's Fisherman's Wharf, offering an integrated experience of shopping, dining, sightseeing tours, and lodging. This tourist-focused destination serves as the perfect starting point for exploring San Francisco's waterfront attractions with convenient access to boutiques, eateries, and tour operators.
demographics: Anchorage Square attracts a diverse mix of domestic and international tourists visiting San Francisco's iconic Fisherman's Wharf area, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-middle income families and couples aged 25-65. The trade area serves as a major tourist destination drawing millions of annual visitors seeking authentic San Francisco experiences, shopping, and waterfront dining. Primary market segments include leisure travelers, cruise ship passengers, and local Bay Area residents seeking entertainment and dining options, with shopping patterns focused on souvenirs, gifts, and experiential activities rather than traditional retail.
description: Anchorage Square stands as a premier destination at the heart of San Francisco's legendary Fisherman's Wharf, where shopping, dining, touring, and lodging converge to create an unforgettable waterfront experience. Located at 2800 Leavenworth Street, this vibrant plaza seamlessly blends retail boutiques, gift shops, and fast-food venues with sightseeing tour operators, making it the perfect launching point for exploring San Francisco's most famous attractions. The center operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, providing unparalleled convenience for both tourists and locals seeking entertainment, dining, and shopping at any hour. Visitors can take advantage of the Anchorage Square Coupon Book, offering exclusive deals from favorite shops, eateries, and attractions throughout the property. With its strategic location near the waterfront and comprehensive mix of retail, dining, touring services, and lodging options including Avis Car Rental and Anchorage Liquor & Deli, Anchorage Square has established itself as an essential stop for anyone experiencing the magic of Fisherman's Wharf and the broader San Francisco Bay Area.
